scope: Milestone5 stored role attestations/read-only capture/research reservations/server decision revalidation; not execution release

findings.title: Protective stop must have correct side/status/symbol/remaining quantity
findings.resolution: Active protective legs now require SELL, us_equity, exact symbol, supported active status, positive stop and enough remaining quantity; unknown protection retains unknown-risk blockers. Reviewer inspected code and the new wrong-status/symbol/quantity/side regression cases.

findings.title: Captured activity day must match operational loss-day policy
findings.resolution: Operational policy is constrained to America/New_York; captures retain activity_trading_day/coverage_start/observed time; checks reject current-day mismatch. Reviewer independently instantiated UTC policy and confirmed rejection.

findings.title: Control revalidation must share writer serialization before first DB read
findings.resolution: A supplied control_check_id acquires the shared controls lock before the first decision DB read. Writers/capture completion/release use the same seeded lock. SQLite begins immediate before prior DB reads; PostgreSQL locks the shared row.

findings.title: Methodology withdrawal needs stable scope and immutable revision/status
findings.resolution: Stable methodology_id separates scope from immutable revision record_id. Explicit APPROVED/PENDING/REVOKED revisions are selected without fallback, and asset approvals pin the exact method revision. Reviewer independently validated a same-scope/new-ID REVOKED contract and read runtime/test guards.

findings.title: Unknown/non-equity/unowned pending broker orders must not bypass exposure checks
findings.resolution: Normalized orders preserve asset_class; unknown/non-us_equity root orders block entry; root SELL totals exceeding observed owned quantity block entry. Remaining nested ordergraph/atomic fill compatibility is a release limitation, not inferred from empty-account probes.

findings.title: Pre-lock timestamps could omit a competitor committed while waiting for serialization
findings.observation: Mutation/evaluation timestamps captured before the global lock could filter later-committed reservations or kill/revocation records from a supposedly serialized current check. Refresh authoritative server time after lock acquisition; retain explicit historical evaluation semantics.
findings.resolution: All mutation clocks refresh after acquiring shared serialization; linked current evaluation refreshes before its first DB read/default cutoff. A reservation or kill committed while waiting is no longer omitted by a stale pre-lock as_of. Explicit request.as_of remains labeled historical research, not execution authority.

remaining_release_conditions: Atomic broker order/fill/cancel/settlement reconciliation and protection lifecycle
Current runtime Alpaca adapter leaves all cash/lending/borrowing/settled-cash proof flags false, so real BUY research checks cannot legitimately pass
Actual empty-account probes do not demonstrate owned sellability or filled/OCO/stop execution semantics
Original Milestones3/4 source/session and verified-market-data release conditions remain separate

review_checks.limits: Separate AI reviewer saw author context and tests; this is not independent empirical broker/market/human truth authentication

post_lock_temporal_re_review.remaining_clock_assumption: Trusted coherent server UTC clock; no order executor or new historical authority is introduced

capture_cli_confidentiality_re_review.finding_origin: Implementation author confidentiality hardening after temporal re-review
capture_cli_confidentiality_re_review.independent_assessment: get_settings, session_factory, capture/read and sanitized report writing are inside the try; SQLAlchemyError/ValueError/OSError/BrokerError now exit with a constant generic message without interpolating exception details. Cleanup retains engine disposal. No state/authority semantics changed.
